description: A flexible-colorway editorial soccer analysis template with tactical, statline, source, and chart layouts for long-form.
primary_publishing_shape: Long-form Vietnamese soccer analysis; platform publishing and platform-specific adaptations are not configured in this package.
renderer_requirement: Keep the Match Dossier identity, adapt team and data colors to the story, and select from tactical, statline, source, and chart plates per beat. Keep Vietnamese copy sparse, omit persistent subtitles, and use only reviewed metrics and citations.
change_policy: No per-content edits to locked design. Changes require a new package version and explicit owner review.
